description: Vendor referenced in prose (article, blog, footer text)
Public integration marker detected or absent only in the declared public capture scope. Not a statement of private connectivity.
JSON-LD org node bound to the account's business
Blog / FAQ / pricing / booking pages present
Completed individual AI-search probe measurement. OBSERVED with cited=false is a valid negative result; failed/unexecuted probes are UNKNOWN.
Positioning / service claims in own words
Share of reviews the business responds to
Pages appeared / removed since last capture
Vendor present in earlier capture, absent now
Share of peers with predicate X
Account rank vs peers on a metric
Derived fact type registered via DerivationFlow (see registry/derivations.json).
Captured press, social, news or case-study publication; publisher claim, not verified execution of a project.
Attributable exact statement, including transcript speaker and optional timecode. Not a verified account operating condition.
Reported corporate event with occurrence and announcement times kept separate.
Public repository change. A dependency is not evidence of production deployment or organization-wide adoption.
Published organizational participation; not attendance, budget or intent.
Permissioned registration/attendance record. Registration and interested are not attendance. Requires authorized scope.
Namespaced reported shipment; not purchase intent or a growth conclusion.
Procurement stage is explicit. A notice is not a won contract.
Exact legal filing/procedural record. Allegations and settlement do not establish wrongdoing or failed AI implementation.
Listing in a named edition; not a current measured growth rate or proof of technical lag.
Patent status and date, not deployed capability or available budget.
System/edition-bound disclosure, not a franchisee-specific revenue assertion.
Financing-statement filing. No assumption about cash received, solvency, growth or spending willingness.
Historical program/loan record. Not current company size, budget or propensity to buy.
Vendor/customer-reported case about the comparison organization, never a claim that KeenSight delivered it.
Reported outcome with denominator/method gaps preserved. Exact percentage is specificity, not credibility or causal proof.
